events.text: The documented journey from Tansyhook Crossing reaches Mossgate Common.

details.describedRoute: Maddoc led Tessa and Bram along the public orchard lane from Tansyhook Crossing, passing hedgerows, fruit carts and a gently climbing footbridge before reaching the village green of Mossgate Common. The ordinary walk posed no unresolved hazard.

hud.name: Maddoc Maddren
hud.weather: Cool and clear, with thin mist between the orchard trees
focus: Explore Mossgate Common's reading room, training yard and beast pens

recap:
CAMPAIGN: Maddoc Maddren (seed 3951775931)
SCENE: At 08:23 Maddoc arrived at Tansyhook Crossing from the Rillbend culvert, leaving the small moss-feathered seed-eating creature alone. Orchard lanes meet at a timber bridge over an irrigation channel beside a covered weigh-shed and fruit-cart layby. Workers tend carts while two local children contest stone-skipping by the railing. Maddoc has not approached or spoken to anyone here.
